result:
I fixed this by widening the `subject` column of `notification_logs` from a 255-character string to `text`. That is where the e-mail subject is stored. I haven't run the migration or any tests.

I inferred the cause from the code rather than reproducing the error. `Notification` fills the subject from a template that includes the class name. It saves that subject to `notification_logs.subject` with a 255-character limit, so a long class name overflows it. I didn't trace the grade-posting flow itself, so I'm assuming that is the code path hitting the error.

The migration is `db/migrate/20241215000000_change_notification_logs_subject_to_text.rb`. I also updated `db/schema.rb` by hand, including the schema version. Run `rails db:migrate` to apply it; it should leave `schema.rb` matching what I edited.

I didn't touch the `subject` column in `email_templates`. It holds the template text, not the formatted subject, so it shouldn't hit this.
